mentions.name: macOS Menu-Bar AI Agent
mentions.description: This macOS menu-bar AI agent drives real desktop apps: hitting ⌘⌘ and typing a task (optionally @-mentioning apps like @slack) dispatches an agent powered by Claude Code or Codex that clicks, types, scrolls, switches apps, and reads the screen via accessibility APIs with a visible cursor so the user can watch it work. Everything runs locally on the user's own logged-in Mac (BYOK to Anthropic/OpenAI) with no cloud VM or re-auth flow; it snapshots the frontmost app for ambient context and supports parallel tasks with persistent history and workspaces. It is pre-release.
